business_line_values.active: The bank runs this business and Yukdhis has its data.
business_line_values.not_onboarded: The bank may run this business, but it is not onboarded in Yukdhis; rules on it cannot be evaluated.
business_line_values.none: The bank does not run this business; rules that only concern it do not apply.

notes: Demo profile used by the applicability gate (pipeline/applicability.py). No treasury derivatives desk and no capital/RWA data are onboarded.
